stem.en: Who is responsible ___ booking the hotel for the trip?

why.en: When we talk about a duty, 'responsible' is followed by 'for'.
why.uz: Majburiyat haqida gap ketganda «responsible» dan keyin «for» keladi.
why.ru: Когда речь об обязанности, после «responsible» используется «for».

why.ru: После «capable» используется «of» + форма на -ing.

why.en: English says 'heavy traffic', not 'strong' or 'big' traffic.
why.uz: Ingliz tilida «heavy traffic» deyiladi, «strong» yoki «big traffic» emas.
why.ru: По-английски говорят «heavy traffic», а не «strong» или «big traffic».

why.ru: «Bear in mind» (или «keep in mind») — помнить, учитывать.

why.ru: Перед существительным «difference» нужно прилагательное: «significant».

stem.en:
"Mistakes are inevitable when you learn a new language," said the teacher.
"Inevitable" means …

why.en: 'Inevitable' means certain to happen and impossible to avoid.
why.uz: «Inevitable» — muqarrar, albatta yuz beradigan.
why.ru: «Inevitable» — неизбежный, то, что обязательно произойдёт.

stem.en: I'm not a big fan of horror films, so I think I'll ___ this time.

why.en: 'Give something a miss' means to decide not to do or attend it; 'give it a go' means to try it.
why.uz: «Give something a miss» — biror narsani qilmaslik yoki unga bormaslikka qaror qilish; «give it a go» — sinab koʻrish.
why.ru: «Give something a miss» — решить не делать или не посещать что-то; «give it a go» — попробовать.

stem.en:
Everyone had told Kamron that the new restaurant was the best in town. After waiting forty minutes for a cold, rather tasteless soup, he paid the bill without leaving a tip and walked out shaking his head.
How did Kamron feel about the restaurant?

options.en: It did not live up to what he had heard.
It was better than people had said.
It was too expensive for him.
It was too far from his home.

why.en: He expected 'the best in town' but got a long wait and a cold, tasteless soup: he was disappointed.
why.uz: U shahardagi eng yaxshi restoranni kutgan edi, lekin uzoq kutish va sovuq, bemaza shoʻrvaga duch keldi — hafsalasi pir boʻldi.
why.ru: Он ожидал «лучший ресторан в городе», а получил долгое ожидание и холодный безвкусный суп — он разочарован.

stem.en:
Thinking of getting a pet? Remember that a dog needs daily walks, regular visits to the vet and company for most of the day. If you work long hours, a cat or a fish may suit your lifestyle better.
What is the main purpose of this text?

options.en: To help readers choose a pet that fits their life.
To persuade readers never to keep a dog.
To explain how to train a dog.

why.en: It lists what a dog needs and suggests other pets for busy people, so it helps readers choose.
why.uz: Matn itga nima kerakligini sanab, band odamlarga boshqa uy hayvonlarini tavsiya qiladi — oʻquvchiga tanlashda yordam beradi.
why.ru: Текст перечисляет, что нужно собаке, и предлагает занятым людям других питомцев — помогает выбрать.

stem.en:
When Zulfiya's manager asked who would volunteer to organise the staff trip, the room went silent. Several people suddenly became very interested in their phones.
What does the writer suggest about the staff?

options.en: Most of them did not want the job.
They were all busy with urgent calls.
They had not heard the question.
They wanted Zulfiya to organise it.

why.en: Silence and a sudden interest in their phones suggest that people were avoiding the task.
why.uz: Jimlik va birdaniga telefonlarga qiziqib qolish odamlar bu vazifadan qochayotganini koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Тишина и внезапный интерес к телефонам показывают, что люди избегали этой задачи.

stem.en:
At the school meeting, the teachers could not agree about homework. Some wanted more of it before the exams; others wanted less, so that students could rest. In the end, this question was left for the next meeting.
What does "this question" refer to?

options.en: how much homework students should get
where the next meeting would be

why.en: 'This question' points back to the disagreement about how much homework to give.
why.uz: «This question» uyga vazifa qancha boʻlishi kerakligi haqidagi kelishmovchilikka ishora qiladi.
why.ru: «This question» относится к спору о том, сколько домашних заданий давать.

stem.en:
Everyone had hoped for an exciting talk, but the director's speech was very dry: he read out long lists of figures for an hour, and half the audience fell asleep.
What does "dry" mean here?

options.en: funny in a quiet, clever way

why.en: The talk was not exciting, it was long lists of figures, and people fell asleep: "dry" here means dull. It was an hour long and read out, so it was neither short nor given without notes.
why.uz: Nutq qiziqarli boʻlmadi: uzun raqamlar roʻyxati oʻqildi, odamlar uxlab qoldi — bu yerda «dry» zerikarli degani. Nutq bir soat davom etgan va qogʻozdan oʻqilgan — demak, u qisqa ham, qogʻozsiz ham emas.
why.ru: Речь не была интересной: длинные списки цифр, и половина зала уснула — здесь «dry» значит «скучный». Она длилась час и читалась по бумаге, значит, не была ни короткой, ни без записей.

stem.en:
Mr Rahimov tells his students: "Staying up until 3 a.m. is not dedication. A tired brain remembers less, so a good night's sleep is part of your studying, not a break from it."
What is Mr Rahimov's main point?

options.en: Sleep is an important part of learning.
Students should study only in the morning.
Students should study fewer hours each day.
Breaks from studying are a waste of time.

why.en: He calls sleep 'part of your studying, not a break from it': rest helps learning.
why.uz: U uyquni «oʻqishning bir qismi, undan tanaffus emas» deb ataydi — dam olish oʻrganishga yordam beradi.
why.ru: Он называет сон «частью учёбы, а не перерывом в ней»: отдых помогает учиться.

stem.en:
Bobur checked the weather forecast twice, packed a spare battery, printed the tickets even though they were on his phone, and arrived at the station an hour early.
What kind of person is Bobur?

why.en: Checking twice, carrying spares and arriving early all show that he is careful and prepared.
why.uz: Ikki marta tekshirish, zaxira batareya olish va erta kelish uning ehtiyotkor va puxta tayyorlanadigan odam ekanini koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Двойная проверка, запасная батарея и приезд заранее показывают, что он осторожный и подготовленный.

stem.en:
The film's story was predictable, and some of the dialogue felt unnatural. Even so, the music and the photography of the mountains were so impressive that I would happily watch it again.
What is the writer's overall opinion of the film?

options.en: Positive, mainly because of how it looks and sounds.
Negative, because the story was weak.
Positive, mainly because of the dialogue.
Neutral: the writer has no clear opinion.

why.en: Despite the weak story, the writer 'would happily watch it again' because of the music and the images.
why.uz: Syujet zaif boʻlsa ham, muallif musiqa va tasvirlar tufayli filmni «yana mamnuniyat bilan koʻrardi».
why.ru: Несмотря на слабый сюжет, автор «с удовольствием посмотрел бы его снова» благодаря музыке и съёмкам.

stem.en:
Since the bakery on our street started selling bread at half price after 6 p.m., the queue outside it every evening has grown longer, while fewer people come in the morning.
What can we infer?

options.en: Some customers now wait until evening to buy cheaper bread.
The bread is fresher in the evening.
The bakery now opens only in the evening.
The morning bread has become more expensive.

why.en: Half-price bread after 6 p.m. explains why more people come in the evening and fewer in the morning.
why.uz: Kechki soat 6 dan keyin non yarim narxda — shuning uchun kechqurun xaridorlar koʻpaygan, ertalab esa kamaygan.
why.ru: Хлеб за полцены после 18:00 объясняет, почему вечером покупателей больше, а утром меньше.

stem.en:
Lost: a small black backpack, left on the number 12 bus on Tuesday afternoon. It contains a green notebook full of drawings that mean a great deal to me. A reward is offered. Please call the number below.
Why does the writer mention the notebook?

options.en: It is the main reason they want the bag back.
To prove that the bag is expensive.
To offer the notebook as a reward.
To describe what was found on the bus.

why.en: The drawings 'mean a great deal' to the writer, so the notebook explains why the bag matters.
why.uz: Rasmlar muallif uchun «juda qadrli» — daftar sumkaning nega muhimligini tushuntiradi.
why.ru: Рисунки «очень много значат» для автора — тетрадь объясняет, почему сумка так важна.

stem.en:
"Your essay has some interesting ideas," said the teacher, "but next time, perhaps check it before you hand it in." Shirin looked at the page, covered in red circles around her spelling.
What does the teacher mean?

options.en: The essay had many careless mistakes.
Shirin handed in the essay late.

why.en: 'Check it before you hand it in' and the red circles around the spelling point to careless mistakes.
why.uz: «Topshirishdan oldin tekshir» degan maslahat va imlo atrofidagi qizil doiralar eʼtiborsizlikdan kelib chiqqan xatolarni bildiradi.
why.ru: Совет «проверь перед сдачей» и красные круги вокруг орфографии указывают на ошибки по невнимательности.

stem.en:
Ravshan has saved money for two years, compared prices in five shops and read dozens of reviews. Yesterday he finally said, "I think I'm ready."
What is Ravshan probably about to do?

options.en: buy something he has long wanted
open a shop of his own
write a review of a shop

why.en: Saving, comparing prices and reading reviews all lead up to an important purchase.
why.uz: Pul yigʻish, narxlarni solishtirish va sharhlarni oʻqish — muhim xarid oldidan qilinadigan ishlar.
why.ru: Накопления, сравнение цен и чтение отзывов — всё это подготовка к важной покупке.
